description: Defines the MimeTypeMap class implementing MimeTypeMapInterface, providing a mapping between filename extensions and MIME types within Drupal core.

classes.name: MimeTypeMap
classes.description: Implements a mapping between filename extensions and MIME types, with methods to add, remove, list, and query MIME types and extensions.

methods.name: addMapping
methods.description: Adds a new MIME type and extension mapping.

methods.name: removeMapping
methods.description: Removes a specific extension mapping for a MIME type.

methods.name: removeMimeType
methods.description: Removes all mappings associated with a MIME type.

methods.name: listMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all MIME types.

methods.name: listExtensions
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all extensions.

methods.name: hasMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type exists in the mapping.

methods.name: hasExtension
methods.description: Checks if an extension exists in the mapping.

methods.name: getMimeTypeForExtension
methods.description: Retrieves the MIME type for a given extension.

methods.name: getExtensionsForMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves all extensions associated with a MIME type.
